title: KernelLake NVMe Cache (OTel)
description: src/storage/nvme_cache_metrics_otel.cpp's kernellake.storage.cache.* instruments (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's "NVMe cache tier" section, "Cache metrics" subsection). No per-series label (one NvmeObjectCache per kernellake-server process, unlike GPU memory's per-gpu.device.id split). Prometheus names verified for real against this exact stack (a real MinIO-backed query round trip, scraped from this stack's own otel-collector/prometheus): kernellake_storage_cache_current_bytes / _current_entries (gauges), kernellake_storage_cache_hits_total / _misses_total / _evictions_total (counters, cumulative since kernellake-server startup). Only populated once storage.cache.enabled is true in config/kernellake-server.yaml and at least one s3://... query has run.
